snippet.title: if you stay // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4437140/if_you_stay

Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer:  YukimiSoft
📚 Publisher:  YukimiSoft
📅 Release Date: Oct 21, 2026
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play, Visual Novel
